$comment: Reference project settings, committed to the repository. This is a statement about the team, not about you — personal preferences belong in ~/.claude/settings.json, and machine-specific ones in .claude/settings.local.json, which is gitignored.
$comment_hooks: Use $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, never a relative path — a relative one resolves against whatever directory the session started in. The hooks object itself takes event names only: a comment inside it makes the whole file fail validation.
